logp.method_description: The log Do/w values of complexes Tc1–Tc2 were determined by the “shake flask” method.28 A mixture of octanol (1 mL) and 0.1 M PBS pH = 7.4 (1 mL) was stirred vigorously, followed by the addition of 25 μL of the aqueous solutions of each complex. The mixtures were vortexed and centrifuged (3000 rpm, 10 min, RT) to allow phase separation. Aliquots of 25 μL of the octanol and PBS phases were counted in a gamma counter. The partition coefficient (Po/w) was calculated by dividing the number of counts of the octanol phase by those from the PBS phase, and the results are expressed as log Do/w.
